summary: Release all single-instance locks created by requestSingleInstanceLock.

target.notes: Release OS-visible ownership so another process can become primary.

caveats: Do not leave background IPC endpoints holding ownership after release.

tests.name: release lock
tests.expected_behavior: another instance may subsequently acquire the lock

tests.name: release without ownership
tests.expected_behavior: must not manufacture ownership or crash solely because no lock is held
